implementation_notes: The AI Act (Regulation EU 2024/1689) entered into force 1 August 2024 with phased applicability: prohibitions from February 2025, GPAI/governance from August 2025, most rules August 2026, high-risk in regulated products August 2027. The Digital Package on Simplification proposes amendments to ease implementation. The AI Pact is a voluntary early-compliance initiative. Enforcement is shared between the European AI Office and national market surveillance authorities.
